name: seo-monster
description: Local, user-credential-driven MCP server for SEO workflows over Google Search Console, GA4, PageSpeed Insights (PSI), Cloudflare, IndexNow, Chrome UX Report (CrUX), and technical-SEO HTTP primitives.
long_description: SEOMonster is an open-source MCP server that exposes strictly SEO-focused tools across Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, PageSpeed Insights (PSI), Cloudflare, IndexNow, the Chrome UX Report (CrUX) History API, and a built-in HTTP client for technical-SEO checks (inspect_meta, check_canonical, redirect_chain_audit, mixed_content_check, robots_txt_validate, sitemap_validate, sitemap_health). All credentials are user-supplied and stay on your machine: nothing is shared with any third party. Reads are always available; the two routine SEO writes (sitemap submit, indexing request) and IndexNow notifications are available by default; only Cloudflare cache-purge tools are gated behind an explicit opt-in.

google_oauth_client.title: Google OAuth Client Secrets JSON
google_oauth_client.description: Path to your Desktop-app OAuth client-secrets JSON, downloaded from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > Credentials > Create credentials > OAuth client ID > Desktop app). Required for Search Console, Indexing, and GA4 tools.

google_token.title: Google OAuth Token Cache Path
google_token.description: Writable path where the cached OAuth token is stored. On first use, a browser opens for one-time consent and the token is written here. Default places it in your home config directory.

gsc_default_site.title: GSC Default Property (optional)
gsc_default_site.description: Default Search Console property for the GSC tools, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com' or 'https://www.example.com/'. You can also pass site_url per call.

ga4_property_id.title: GA4 Default Property ID (optional)
ga4_property_id.description: Default GA4 property for the GA4 tools, e.g. 'properties/123456789' or bare '123456789'. You can also pass property_id per call.

psi_api_key.title: PageSpeed Insights API Key (optional)
psi_api_key.description: Optional. PSI works anonymously; a key only raises rate limits. Create one in Google Cloud Console after enabling the PageSpeed Insights API.

cf_api_token.title: Cloudflare API Token (optional)
cf_api_token.description: Bearer token for the Cloudflare tools. Generate at dash.cloudflare.com > My Profile > API Tokens with Zone:Read, DNS:Read, Account Analytics:Read, and (only if you enable destructive mode) Cache Purge:Purge.

cf_zone.title: Cloudflare Default Zone Hostname (optional)
cf_zone.description: Default zone hostname for the Cloudflare tools, e.g. 'example.com'. You can also pass zone per call.

indexnow_key.title: IndexNow Key (optional)
indexnow_key.description: Shared key used to submit URLs to Bing/Yandex/Naver/Seznam/Yep via IndexNow. Any 8-128 hex string you generate; engines verify ownership by fetching https://<your-host>/<key>.txt. See https://www.indexnow.org/documentation. Required only if you want to use indexnow_submit / indexnow_bulk_submit.

indexnow_key_location.title: IndexNow Key File URL (optional)
indexnow_key_location.description: Override the default verification location (https://<host>/<key>.txt). Set only if you host the key file at a non-standard path.

tools.name: system_status
tools.description: Discovery tool. Reports which services are configured/reachable, the Google auth method and scopes, whether destructive mode is on, and the full tool catalog. Call this first when unsure of the setup.

tools.name: gsc_list_properties
tools.description: List every Search Console property the configured credentials can see, with each property's permission level.

tools.name: gsc_search_analytics
tools.description: The workhorse GSC tool: clicks, impressions, CTR, and position by dimensions, date range, dimension filters, and data_state.

tools.name: gsc_top_queries
tools.description: Convenience wrapper: top queries for a property by clicks over the last N days.

tools.name: gsc_top_pages
tools.description: Convenience wrapper: top pages for a property by clicks over the last N days.

tools.name: gsc_compare_periods
tools.description: Compare two equal-length time windows (current vs prior) and return per-key deltas in clicks, impressions, CTR, and position, plus keys present in only one window.

tools.name: gsc_inspect_url
tools.description: Inspect a single URL via the URL Inspection API: index verdict, coverage state, crawl info, canonicals, and mobile/rich-results summaries when present.

tools.name: gsc_batch_inspect_urls
tools.description: Inspect up to 25 URLs in one call. Per-URL failures are collected so a transient error does not fail the whole batch.

tools.name: gsc_list_sitemaps
tools.description: List the sitemaps Google knows about for a property, with submission and indexing status.

tools.name: gsc_submit_sitemap
tools.description: Submit a sitemap to Search Console. Routine SEO write, available by default; requires the writable webmasters scope.

tools.name: gsc_request_indexing
tools.description: Request (re)crawl of one or more URLs via the Indexing API (URL_UPDATED). Routine SEO write, available by default; requires the indexing scope.

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description: Workhorse GA4 tool: run a Google Analytics 4 report with arbitrary dimensions, metrics, date range, optional dimension filter, and ordering.

tools.name: ga4_top_landing_pages
tools.description: Convenience: top landing pages by sessions, filtered to organic search by default. Returns engagement rate and conversions alongside sessions.

tools.name: ga4_traffic_by_channel
tools.description: Convenience: sessions, engaged sessions, and conversions broken down by default channel group. Separates organic from paid / referral / direct at a glance.

tools.name: ga4_organic_search_overview
tools.description: Organic-search health: window totals (sessions, engaged sessions, engagement rate, average session duration, conversions) plus a day-by-day trend.

tools.name: psi_analyze
tools.description: Run PageSpeed Insights on a URL. Returns Lighthouse category scores, lab Core Web Vitals, and field Core Web Vitals (CrUX) when available.

tools.name: cf_list_zones
tools.description: List the Cloudflare zones the API token can see, with status, plan, and id.

tools.name: cf_zone_info
tools.description: Zone overview for a hostname: status, plan, paused, name servers, created and modified timestamps.

tools.name: cf_list_dns
tools.description: List DNS records for a zone (read-only). Useful for verifying the canonical host and TXT verification records during SEO migrations.

tools.name: cf_web_analytics
tools.description: Read-only Cloudflare Web Analytics (edge RUM). Lists all account sites or returns a single site by hostname or tag. Complements GA4 with edge-measured visits.

tools.name: cf_purge_cache
tools.description: Purge specific URLs from the Cloudflare cache so crawlers refetch updated content. Gated: requires SEO_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true.

tools.name: cf_purge_cache_all
tools.description: Purge the entire Cloudflare cache for a zone. Gated: requires SEO_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true AND a confirm value equal to the resolved zone hostname.

tools.name: indexnow_submit
tools.description: Submit a single URL to IndexNow (Bing + Yandex + Naver + Seznam + Yep). Complements gsc_request_indexing for the non-Google engines.

tools.name: indexnow_bulk_submit
tools.description: Submit up to 10,000 URLs sharing the same host to IndexNow in one batched request.

tools.name: gsc_query_opportunities
tools.description: Queries already ranking in the top N positions but with below-target CTR. Title and meta optimization candidates.

tools.name: gsc_query_gaps
tools.description: Queries that draw impressions but barely any clicks. Content opportunity signal.

tools.name: gsc_new_queries
tools.description: Queries with impressions in the current window and zero impressions in the prior window. Emerging topics.

tools.name: gsc_top_pages_by_query
tools.description: Which pages rank for a specific query. The cannibalization audit input.

tools.name: inspect_meta
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its on-page SEO surface: title, meta description, robots, canonical, OG/Twitter cards, hreflang, H1 count.

tools.name: check_canonical
tools.description: Analyse a page's canonical link tag: self-referential? cross-host? protocol-mismatched? trailing-slash drift? canonical target reachable?

tools.name: mixed_content_check
tools.description: Fetch an HTTPS page and report any http:// sub-resource references (img/script/iframe/form). No-op for http:// pages.

tools.name: redirect_chain_audit
tools.description: Walk a URL's redirect chain hop by hop. Flag long chains, protocol downgrades, loops, and non-2xx terminus.

tools.name: robots_txt_validate
tools.description: Parse robots.txt: per-group rules + sitemaps. Optionally verdict a list of (user_agent, url) probes using RFC 9309 longest-match semantics.

tools.name: sitemap_validate
tools.description: Validate a sitemap or sitemap-index XML, count entries, flag oversize (>50k URLs or >50 MiB), cross-host entries, and missing lastmod. .gz transparent.

tools.name: sitemap_health
tools.description: Sample N URLs from a sitemap (or index), HEAD-check each, return a status histogram and the first non-2xx examples.

tools.name: crux_history
tools.description: Return the last 25 weekly periods of Core Web Vitals at p75 (LCP, INP, CLS, ...) for a URL or origin via the Chrome UX Report History API.

tools.name: inspect_schema
tools.description: Extract every JSON-LD block from a page and report schema.org @type counts plus a sample entity per type.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Validate JSON-LD blocks against the Google Rich Results required-field set. Covers Article, Product, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Organization, LocalBusiness, Event, Review, Recipe.

tools.name: hreflang_consistency_check
tools.description: Cross-page hreflang audit. Flags missing reciprocity, broken targets, duplicate hreflang, missing self-link, missing x-default.

tools.name: internal_link_graph
tools.description: Small BFS crawl from a starting URL within the same host. Returns per-page in/out-degree, orphans, broken internal links, depth distribution.

tools.name: lighthouse_budget
tools.description: Run PSI and verdict the results against a performance budget (Lighthouse scores + lab Core Web Vitals). Per-metric pass/fail plus overall verdict.

tools.name: gsc_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Multi-property fleet view. Per-property one-row summary (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) over the last N days, plus a portfolio-level rollup. Honors include/exclude filters.

tools.name: gsc_trending_pages
tools.description: Pages whose impressions grew most over the last N days vs the prior N days. Wrapper on gsc_compare_periods with dimensions=['page'], sort_by='delta_impressions', sort_dir='desc'.

tools.name: gsc_decaying_pages
tools.description: Pages whose impressions fell most over the last N days vs the prior N days. Same wrapper as trending_pages but ascending sort.

tools.name: gsc_coverage_audit
tools.description: Heuristic coverage audit (GSC Index Coverage report is not exposed in the API). Bulk-inspects user-supplied URLs, returns per-URL verdict and rollup verdict_counts + coverage_state_counts.
